data.one_liner: Searchable single and multi-select dropdowns with accent‑insensitive search and CRUD support
data.what_it_does: Provides two widgets, SearchDropDown and MultipleSearchDropDown, that let users pick one or many items from a list. The widgets support filtering, adding, editing, deleting items, keyboard navigation, theming, and localization.
use_when: You need a dropdown that can handle long lists and allow users to search quickly
You want to let users create, edit or delete items directly in the dropdown
You need Material 3 theming and accessibility features out of the box
avoid_when: You only need a simple static dropdown with no search or CRUD
You are building a highly custom UI that requires full control over the list rendering
strengths: Accent‑ and case‑insensitive search by default
Controller‑driven API that keeps its own state
Keyboard navigation and accessibility out of the box
weaknesses: No support for custom item types beyond ValueItem without custom builder
Limited to dropdown style UI, not a full form field library
No built‑in persistence; callbacks must handle storage
data.setup_notes: Add dependency in pubspec and import package; no special permissions or build_runner needed
